component.name: Argon
component.summary: Calm, minimal, developer-oriented browser built on Gecko

description.p: Argon is an independent browser fork based on LibreWolf and Firefox (Gecko/SpiderMonkey) with a flat Obsidian and warm Ivory design system, native horizontal and vertical tab layouts, hardened privacy defaults, and zero first-party telemetry or remote experiment enrollment.
Argon Browser Public Beta for Linux (Flatpak):

ul.li: Customizable Obsidian and Ivory design system with live accent, density, corner radius, toolbar placement, and horizontal/vertical tab layout controls.
Container-isolated workspaces, pinned per-workspace tabs, configurable keyboard shortcuts, and modular New Tab page.
Integrated uBlock Origin filtering core with off-main-thread compilation and verified bundled filter lists, plus GhostPrint default anti-fingerprinting.
Native onboarding wizard, hardened LibreWolf privacy defaults, and Chromium Manifest V3 extension compatibility analyzer and runtime bridge.
